newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate up to 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate up to 11.7 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average lending rate edged up 60 basis points to 11.7 percent amid high demand for kuna funds which was fully matched by an abundant supply.
Settlements totalled 31.8 million kuna, up considerably from Wednesday's 18 million.
Fresh loans accounted for 23.2 million kuna, of which most were for call money granted at 11 percent.
Term rates ranged between 9 and 14 percent.
Insurers and banks rolled over a total of 8.6 million kuna at 9 and at 13-16 percent, respectively.
The central bank calculated its kuna mid-rates for Friday firmer at 5.8452 for the dollar and 3.5633 for the German mark.
